description: Detect blind command injection via time delay and OOB callbacks. Tests sleep-based delay detection and optional out-of-band (curl/nslookup to callback). Returns time_based results array and oob_payloads list. Side effects: Executes sleep on target if vulnerable. OOB payloads call back to callback_url.

callback_url.description: Out-of-band callback URL for OOB detection (e.g. Burp Collaborator)

name: cmdi_blind_detect
